title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Calculation Standard for Compensation for Infringement of Citizens' Personal Freedom in State Compensation Decisions Made in 2023
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Calculation Standard for Compensation for Infringement of Personal Freedom in State Compensation Decisions Made in 2023

Fa [2023] No. 77

To: All Higher People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The National Bureau of Statistics announced on May 9, 2023, that the average annual wage of employed persons in urban non-private units nationwide in 2022 was RMB 114,029. According to the formula for calculating the daily average wage provided by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the daily average wage is RMB 436.89. Pursuant to Article 33 of the State Compensation Law and Article 21, Paragraph 2 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Compensation Cases, when making state compensation decisions from May 10, 2023, onward, the people's courts at all levels shall calculate compensation for infringement of personal freedom at the rate of RMB 436.89 per day.

This notice is hereby issued, and all parties are requested to comply accordingly.

May 10, 2023
